headline: Bank of Korea Releases November Economic Sentiment Survey
summary: The Bank of Korea published its November 2026 Business Survey and Economic Sentiment Index to evaluate business conditions across domestic industries.
why: The Bank of Korea is South Korea's central bank, regulating monetary policy and tracking macroeconomic sentiment in Asia's fourth-largest economy.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Economic sentiment survey provides macro insights into South Korea's broader corporate health.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
